// def.ts — A DEFAULT EXPORT THAT NAMES NOTHING, and nothing else.
//
// `export default 42` offers the external name `default` and there is no
// internal name anywhere in the program to put in the other column: babel
// gives the ExportDefaultDeclaration a `declaration` child with no `id`.
// exp.ts carries the NAMED half; the two cannot live in one module, because
// the grammar allows one default export per file — which is also the invariant
// `default_conflict[audit]` states.
//
// IT IMPORTS NOTHING AND IS IMPORTED BY NOTHING, for the same reason exp.ts
// imports nothing: every module-site relation in test/js-modules.test.ts is
// asserted set for set against node's own resolver, and a file that adds no
// site adds nothing to either side of that comparison.
export default 42;
